meta.title: Merchant Onboarding — Checkout.com
meta.description: Onboarding guide for crypto and iGaming merchants at Checkout.com.

hero.title: Getting started with Checkout.com
hero.lede: A step-by-step guide for crypto and iGaming merchants — what to prepare, how onboarding works, and which products fit your business.

steps.title: Onboarding steps
steps.lede: The end-to-end path from application to going live.

s1.title: Apply & submit KYC/KYB
s1.body: Provide company details and complete Know-Your-Business verification.

s2.title: Risk & compliance review
s2.body: Underwriting assesses your business model, licensing, and MCC.

s3.title: Integration & testing
s3.body: Connect via API or Flow in sandbox, then validate test transactions.

s4.title: Go live
s4.body: Move to production credentials and process live payments.

prepare.title: What to prepare
prepare.lede: Have these ready to speed up onboarding.

p1.title: Corporate documents
p1.body: Certificate of incorporation, ownership structure, director IDs.

p2.title: Licensing
p2.body: Relevant operating licenses for your jurisdiction and vertical.

p3.title: Processing history
p3.body: Recent statements and volumes, if you have a processing history.

crypto.body: VASP registration and proof of regulatory status where applicable.

igaming.body: Gambling license(s) per operating market and responsible-gaming policy.

products.title: Product types
products.lede: Ways to accept and pay out with Checkout.com.

p1.title: Flow & Frames
p1.body: Drop-in, customisable payment components for the web.

p2.title: Payments API
p2.body: Full API control over cards, APMs, and 3DS.

p3.title: Payouts
p3.body: Send funds to cards and accounts, including AFT flows.

demo.title: Live payment demo
demo.lede: Explore a real Flow payment experience — customise appearance, locale, and payment methods.
